# Protected Files — Constitution Principle II
#
# These files are critical to repository governance, testing, and integration.
# Changes require explicit owner approval and must link to an approved change-request issue.
#
# List Format: Path pattern (one per line, extended regular expressions with anchors)
# Patterns are matched with: git diff --name-only | grep -E "^{pattern}"
# Note: Use anchors (^ for start, $ for end) and escape metacharacters (\. \/ etc)
#
# Protected File Categories:
# 1. Governance files (.github/) — workflows, labels, issue types, templates
# 2. Repository rules (scripts/, AGENTS.md, guidelines/) — infrastructure and standards
# 3. Release artifacts (CHANGELOG.md, ATTRIBUTIONS.md) — version history and credits
# 4. Integration components — Supabase utilities, Figma components
# 5. Task tracking — task-list.md (never delete)
